I can't say whether this asset is deforestation-free, because the analysis didn't produce any result.

The run for ASSET-K (12 Nov 2026) failed at the land-change step. The tool reported that the source coverage the asset needs hadn't been prepared, so no observations were made. The run metadata also shows no asset area (null), which suggests the asset's footprint wasn't fully resolved.

This is not evidence of no deforestation. It means nothing was checked against the baseline of 31 Dec 2020, using the Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change data and the JRC 2020 forest cover reference.

Next steps:
- Have the coverage for this asset prepared, then rerun the analysis.
- Check that the asset's geometry and area are loaded correctly.
- Until then, treat the asset's status as undetermined.

Also note that the engine is an early-access version (land-change/1), which is worth keeping in mind when interpreting future results.
